packages.label: תְּפִלָּה וּמָשִׁיחַ
packages.reason: All these concepts share the essential nature of תְּפִלָּה as the supreme weapon and life-force of Mashiach. The Torah opens: 'עִקַּר כְּלֵי-זֵינוֹ שֶׁל מָשִׁיחַ הוּא הַתְּפִלָּה'. Everything here IS prayer from a different angle: חֹטֶם (the nose = organ of prayer), כְּבוֹד אֵל (the glory-name of prayer), חֶרֶב/בְּחַרְבִּי (sword = prayer per Rashi), בְּכוֹרָה (firstborn status = the service of prayer), אֱמוֹר (speech addressed to God = prayer), כְּלֵי-זֵינוֹ (weapon = prayer), מָשִׁיחַ (whose essence is prayer). The Tzaddik-Moshe cluster (צַדִּיק, מֹשֶׁה, מָשִׁיחַ, מָאוֹר הַגָּדוֹל, צַדִּיק הַדּוֹר, דָּג) is here because 'כָּל צַדִּיק שֶׁבַּדּוֹר הוּא בְּחִינַת מֹשֶׁה מָשִׁיחַ' — the Tzaddik IS the aspect of Mashiach IS the aspect of prayer. The Mishkan cluster (אֵיבָר מֵהַשְּׁכִינָה, אֶבְרֵי הַמִּשְׁכָּן) is here because each prayer IS a limb of the Shechina = a board of the Mishkan. The two-mouth cluster (פִּי שְׁנַיִם, שְׁתֵּי פִּיּוֹת, חֶרֶב פִּיפִיּוֹת) is here because prayer IS double-mouthed (praise + petition). The sun/moon cluster (מָאוֹר הַגָּדוֹל = Tzaddik/Moshe, מָאוֹר הַקָּטָן = prayer/small people) mirrors the way the Tzaddik illuminates prayer.
merge_notes: Component M (דג / צדיק הדור) merged in: text states 'חָזִינָא לְהַאי כַּוְרָא הוּא בְּחִינַת צַדִּיק הַדּוֹר, הַנִּקְרָא דָּג, זֶה בְּחִינַת מֹשֶׁה מָשִׁיחַ' — the fish IS the Tzaddik IS Moshe-Mashiach IS prayer. Same essential nature as the rest of this package.

packages.label: תּוֹרָה וּנְשָׁמוֹת
packages.reason: These concepts all share the essential nature of Torah as the medium that carries souls (נְשָׁמוֹת). The Torah says: 'הַשָּׁמַיִם מְסַפְּרִים כְּבוֹד אֵל, הַיְנוּ הַתּוֹרָה שֶׁהוּא אֵשׁ וּמַיִם, הַיְנוּ בְּחִינַת הַנְּשָׁמוֹת.' Torah IS fire-and-water (אֵשׁ וּמַיִם) which IS souls. The heavens (שָׁמַיִם) = fire-and-water (the very etymology of שמים = אש + מים), and thus the heavens too share this nature. כֹּהֲנִים (priests) = Torah = souls: 'כֹּהֲנִים הֵם בְּחִינַת תּוֹרָה, בְּחִינַת נְשָׁמוֹת.' Souls are called עֲשָׂבִין (grasses/herbs), the organic dimension of their vitality. These concepts form the Torah-soul cluster that enters into prayer, illuminating it from within.

packages.label: מִשְׁפָּט וְיַעֲקֹב
packages.label_en: Judgment and Jacob — the Middle Column
packages.reason: All these concepts share the essential nature of מִשְׁפָּט as the straight, middle-column principle that allows precise spiritual aim. The Torah states: 'מִשְׁפָּט הוּא עַמּוּדָא דְּאֶמְצָעִיתָא' — judgment is the central pillar of balance. מִשְׁפָּט IS עַמּוּדָא דְּאֶמְצָעִיתָא (same nature). מִשְׁפָּט IS עֵינִין (eyes) — 'מִשְׁפָּט הוּא בְּחִינַת עֵינִין, עֵין מִשְׁפָּט.' עֵינִין IS יַעֲקֹב — 'עֵין יַעֲקֹב.' יַעֲקֹב IS מִשְׁפָּט — 'מִשְׁפָּטֵיךָ לְמֶלֶךְ תֵּן, מִשְׁפָּט וּצְדָקָה בְּיַעֲקֹב.' אַהֲרֹן IS מִשְׁפָּט — he bore the מִשְׁפַּט of Israel on his breastplate. 'אֲנִי' (the first person) IS מִשְׁפָּט — 'וַאֲנִי נָתַתִּי לְךָ... אֲנִי דַּיְקָא, שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת מִשְׁפָּט.' These are all aspects of the quality of balanced, discerning judgment that calibrates prayer and charity to the exact right measure.

packages.label: שְׁמִירַת הַבְּרִית וְיוֹסֵף
packages.reason: All these concepts share the essential nature of שְׁמִירַת הַבְּרִית — the guarding of the covenant of purity as the channel through which the weapon of prayer is received. יוֹסֵף IS שְׁמִירַת הַבְּרִית — the paradigm of sexual purity: 'בְּחִינַת יוֹסֵף, הַיְנוּ שְׁמִירַת הַבְּרִית.' טָהֳרָה (purity) IS שְׁמִירַת הַבְּרִית — purity and covenant-keeping are the same essential quality (the Zohar: 'עִקָּרָא דְּיִצְרָא בִּישָׁא עַל עֲרַיָן'). לֹא יִטַּמָּא IS שְׁמִירַת הַבְּרִית — the commandment 'do not defile yourself among your people' is the aspect of covenant-guarding. חֹק IS בְּרִית — 'כִּי חֹק לְיִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא, בְּחִינַת בְּרִית, כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב: חֹק בִּשְׁאֵרוֹ שָׂם' — the statute placed in the flesh IS the covenant. This package represents the bodily/spiritual purification that is prerequisite to receiving the prayer-weapon.
merge_notes: Component H (חֹק / בְּרִית) merged in: the proof 'כִּי חֹק לְיִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא, בְּחִינַת בְּרִית, כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב: חֹק בִּשְׁאֵרוֹ שָׂם' directly equates חֹק with בְּרִית, and the entire purity cluster IS covenant. Same essential nature.

packages.label: הֲכָנַת הַשְּׁכִינָה לְזִוּוּג
packages.reason: These concepts all share the essential nature of the Shechina's preparation for union (זִוּוּג) through the accumulation of prayers. The Torah expounds on the Agadic fish-story: 'אֲפִינָן וּבַשְׁלִינָן' (we baked and cooked it) = 'כִּי אֲפִיָּה וּבִשּׁוּל הֵם הֲכָנָה לָאֲכִילָה, לִבְחִינַת זִוּוּג.' Baking (אֲפִיָּה) IS preparation-for-zivug. Cooking (בִּשּׁוּל) IS preparation-for-zivug. Eating (אֲכִילָה) IS zivug — 'כִּי אִם הַלֶּחֶם אֲשֶׁר הוּא אוֹכֵל' refers to Yosef's eating = zivug. הֲכָנָה לָאֲכִילָה IS זִוּוּג (they describe the same reality: the Shechina ripening toward divine union). This package describes the teleological end-state toward which the accumulation of prayers drives: when enough prayers accumulate, the Shechina is fully prepared and zivug occurs, bringing redemption.
merge_notes: Component G (אֲכִילָה / זִוּוּג) merged in: the proof 'לָאֲכִילָה, לִבְחִינַת זִוּוּג, כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב: כִּי אִם הַלֶּחֶם אֲשֶׁר הוּא אוֹכֵל' equates eating with zivug. Eating IS the culmination of the baking/cooking preparation (הֲכָנָה), making it the same thematic domain: the Shechina's progresssive preparation for and arrival at divine union.

packages.label: קִלְקוּל הַמִּשְׁפָּט וּמַחֲשָׁבוֹת זָרוֹת
packages.label_en: Corruption of Judgment and Foreign Thoughts — the Evil Mirror of Mishpat
packages.reason: These concepts are the evil mirror of Package 3 (מִשְׁפָּט וְיַעֲקֹב). Where Package 3 is the good, centered, eye-opening quality of mishpat, this package represents its perversion and corruption. קִלְקוּל הַמִּשְׁפָּט IS שֹּׁחַד (bribery) — 'כִּי הַשֹּׁחַד יְעַוֵּר עֵינֵי חֲכָמִים' means that taking a bribe IS the corruption of judgment (same nature — the act defines the state). קִלְקוּל לָעֵינִין IS מַחֲשָׁבוֹת זָרוֹת שֶׁבַּתְּפִלָּה — the blinding of the eyes IS foreign thoughts in prayer (same essential nature: spiritual blindness = inability to see straight in prayer). יְעַוֵּר (blinding) IS קִלְקוּל לָעֵינִין — the act of blinding IS the state of corrupted vision. עֲנָנִין דִּמְכַסִּין עַל עֵינִין IS מַחֲשָׁבוֹת זָרוֹת שֶׁבַּתְּפִלָּה — the clouds covering the eyes IS foreign thoughts (same metaphysical reality described in two registers). These concepts share the nature of 'spiritual blindness induced by moral perversion,' the anti-pole to the clear vision of mishpat.
merge_notes: Component L (שֹּׁחַד / קִלְקוּל הַמִּשְׁפָּט) merged in: שֹּׁחַד IS bechina of קִלְקוּל הַמִּשְׁפָּט (edge 2633, reference=2, type=bechina). Both are aspects of the same evil domain: the perversion of mishpat that leads to spiritual blindness. They share the same essential nature as Components D (קִלְקוּל לָעֵינִין / מַחֲשָׁבוֹת זָרוֹת). The L-to-D connection appears as eitza in the dataset (edge 2635, type=eitza) but thematically שֹּׁחַד/קִלְקוּל הַמִּשְׁפָּט and קִלְקוּל לָעֵינִין/מַחֲשָׁבוֹת זָרוֹת are all aspects of the same evil: the corruption of spiritual vision.

packages.label: חֶסֶד וְרַחֲמִים בְּגָלוּת
packages.label_en: Chesed and Mercy in Exile — the Divine Face and the Ship
packages.reason: These concepts all share the essential nature of the divine attribute-structure in exile: the two faces of God's engagement with Israel in galut, and the grace (chesed) that preserves them. פָּנֶיךָ IS רַחֲמִים — 'הִסְתַּרְתָּ פָנֶיךָ, שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינוֹת רַחֲמִים' — God's face is the aspect of mercy. פָּנָה עֹרֶף IS דִּין — 'פָּנָה עֹרֶף שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינוֹת דִּין' — God's turning away is the aspect of strict judgment. These two pairs (panim/rachamin and oref/din) are explicitly mirror aspects of the same divine reality in exile: one is God facing us (rachamin), the other is God's back to us (din). The ship/chesed pair (סְפִינְתָּא IS חֶסֶד, 'הַסַּפָּנִין רֻבָּן חֲסִידִים') anchors this package: the 'ship' that saves us in the stormy exile IS divine chesed without which we would drown. This package is marked neutral because these divine attributes (chesed, din, rachamin) are structural features of the divine-cosmic order — they appear in both redemptive and punitive registers depending on context.
merge_notes: Components I (פָּנָה עֹרֶף / דִּין), J (סְפִינְתָּא / חֶסֶד), and K (פָּנֶיךָ / רַחֲמִים) merged into one package. All three are aspects of the same thematic domain: God's relationship with Israel in galut expressed through attribute-language (face/back = mercy/judgment) and the metaphor of salvation (the ship = chesed). פָּנֶיךָ/רַחֲמִים and פָּנָה עֹרֶף/דִּין are explicitly presented as the two sides of the same exilic reality in the same paragraph of the Torah source. The ship/chesed pair belongs here because it resolves the din/oref situation — chesed is what saves from the stern judgment of galut.
